rice.region: Eastern Uttar Pradesh (Middle Gangetic Plain Agro-Climatic Zone)
rice.soil_fertility_class: Medium Fertility (Available N: 250-400 kg/ha, P: 10-25 kg/ha, K: 150-250 kg/ha)
rice.assumptions: Package of practices for semi-dwarf high-yielding rice in medium-fertility alluvial plains under irrigated conditions.
rice.disclaimer: Please adjust based on local agricultural department (KVK) / official Soil Health Card advice. Actual field-level nutrient requirements must be verified with an official soil test.
rice.source_citation: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI) Bulletin on Nutrient Management in Alluvial Soils & UPCAR Agronomic Guidelines

provenance.source: ICAR-NRRI / UPCAR Package of Practices (Medium Soil Fertility Benchmark)
provenance.geographic_scope: Middle Gangetic Plain (Eastern UP Alluvial Zone)
provenance.methodology_note: Nutrient guidance calculated from ICAR general fertility tables for medium fertility soils. Not field-tested on this specific parcel.

wheat.assumptions: Irrigated timely sown wheat in alluvial loamy soils following Kharif rice.
wheat.disclaimer: Verify with soil test before field application. Adjust based on local KVK guidance.
wheat.source_citation: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Package of Practices for NEPZ

provenance.methodology_note: Guideline values for medium soil fertility class.

maize.assumptions: Hybrid Kharif maize under well-drained loamy condition.
maize.disclaimer: Split nitrogen application (1/3 basal, 1/3 knee-high, 1/3 tasseling) is recommended.

provenance.methodology_note: Guideline values for hybrid maize in medium-fertility soils.
